raw.description:
About the role

Our sales team are the main point of call for our customers and the front line of our business. As we continue to grow, we’re expanding our team and we need ambitious, dedicated salespeople to join us across a range of roles and areas.

We’re looking for people with an entrepreneurial attitude, who treat their portfolio like it’s their own business, constantly striving for profitable growth, new wins and strong customer relationships.

In return, you’ll get the backing of one of the fastest growing power businesses in Europe.

Responsibilities


  • Building strong relationships with your customers to drive share of wallet and profitable account growth

  • Seek out and win new business opportunities to grow your portfolio

  • Utilise CRM to report on your portfolio growth, pipeline and constantly improve your sales strategy

  • Work collaboratively with the wider sales team, operations and support functions to deliver an exceptional service every single time

What we need from you


  • A strong growth mindset, focused on profit

  • Ability to seek out new business and deliver value

  • Relationship building skills that add value internally and externally

  • Experience in a results driven sales role is essential, but this doesn’t have to be in the power or rental industry. We offer full technical and product training

What we offer you


  • Competitive base salary and uncapped bonus potential based on performance

  • Development opportunities – including upskill training and progression paths

  • Regular recognition campaigns and away days

  • Added benefits such as healthcare coverage, holiday buy and company car

  • The chance to join one of the fastest growing power businesses in Europe

Who are CES Power?

The short answer is we’re an electrical infrastructure engineering company ​who happen to rent generators.

What does that mean? It means we’re trusted to power some of the biggest festivals, record breaking tours and critical infrastructure projects in the world.

Founded in the US, our business in the UK and Europe has grown significantly in the past three years via acquisition and multi-million fleet investment. We’re looking for driven salespeople who want to help us continue our ambitious growth plans.

Diversity

Here at CES

we know that the best performing teams welcome people from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences, and we’re dedicated to building high performing teams where everyone feels valued. No matter your background, if you’re ready to help us build something powerful, get in touch. We’d love to have a conversation.

Job Summary:TheProduct Managerowns the end-to-end lifecycle of new and existingdigital applications, ensuring they solve real user problems and support business growth. This role combines product management with customer experience research, conductingmarket and usability research and developing adoption strategies to support successfulproduct launches and long term user retention.

What does a day in the life of a Product Manager look like?

  • Own and define product features and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and the customer journey.

  • Design and execute market research and competitive analysis to identify market gaps, user personas, and emerging customer needs.

  • Conduct customer discovery, user interviews, and usability testing to identify friction

points and validate prototypes before development.

  • Develop onboarding flows and adoption strategies to support user acquisition and product adoption.

  • Partner with Engineering, UX/UI Designers, Customer Success, and Marketing to translate customer insights into feature specifications (PRDs) and user stories.

  • Lead the creation and maintenance of product documentation, including feature specifications, release notes, and SOPs for internal teams.

  • Define, track, and analyze key product metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, churn, DAU/MAU, NPS) to inform feature iteration.

  • Partner with customer-facing teams to deliver product enablement training, ensuring support staff are aligned with the customer journey.

  • Adhere to company policies and procedures

  • Meet or exceed performance targets for related KPIs

  • Continuously improve knowledge of product management methodologies, customer experience research, and industry best practices through training and learning initiatives

  • Collaborate with other departments as needed

  • Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times

  • Perform other duties as assigned

What are the required qualifications of a Product Manager?

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in product management, preferably owning digital products, mobile/web applications, or SaaS solutions.

  • Hands-on experience conducting qualitative user research (e.g., usability testing, customer interviews) and quantitative analysis.

  • Experience applying testing and optimization frameworks (e.g., A/B testing, funnel analysis, onboarding flow design) to improve product adoption.

  • Experience with product analytics platforms (e.g., Firebase, Amplitude, Hotjar, GA4) and agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, ClickUp).

  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to translate user feedback into clear technical requirements.

  • Retirement Savings Program with Company Matching

  • HMO coverage starting on Day 1

  • Paid time off, birthday leave

  • Bonus and incentive plans

  • Opportunities for skills training and personal and professional development

  • Beautiful office space with a free lunch provided daily for onsite employees

  • Employee Referral Program

🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to Lead and Scale Our E-Commerce Operations?

At Hadley Designs, we believe learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and educators trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are looking for an E-Commerce Business Manager to join our team and help scale our online sales. If you are a results-driven operator with a passion for building scalable e-commerce systems, optimizing performance, and driving growth through data-backed strategies, this is a unique opportunity to make an impact.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity, heart, and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools empower families and teachers to make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission
We design screen-free products that parents trust to help their children grow, learn, and reach their full potential. Our beautifully crafted, developmentally sound tools replace distractions with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As the E-Commerce Business Manager, you will own the full P&L of Hadley Designs’ e-commerce operations, with a focus on growing our Amazon business and expanding our multi-channel online presence. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, optimizing product positioning, managing pricing, and leading promotional strategies across multiple online platforms. This is a high-impact role where your strategic and operational expertise will be critical to scaling the business and ensuring the long-term success of our e-commerce channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End E-Commerce Ownership: Manage all aspects of the e-commerce business, including revenue growth, margin optimization, pricing, advertising, and inventory management.
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously optimize product listings, content, pricing strategies, and promotional plans to maximize conversion rates, sales, and profitability.
  • New Product and Category Growth: Identify new product opportunities and market expansion avenues, and collaborate with internal teams to bring them to market successfully.
  • Inventory and Demand Planning: Develop and execute plans to manage product demand, inventory levels, and risk mitigation, ensuring smooth and cost-effective operations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Operations, Supply Chain, and Design teams to ensure product availability and accurate messaging across channels.
  • Data-Driven Strategy: Use data to guide decision-making, refine strategies, and improve key performance metrics across e-commerce platforms.

How Success is Measured

  • Strong growth in online sales and profitability across multiple platforms, especially Amazon.
  • Clear and predictable performance improvements through optimized strategies in pricing, promotions, and product listings.
  • Consistent execution of marketing and sales strategies to expand market share.
  • Efficient inventory management that balances growth with cost control.
  • Cross-functional alignment that contributes to operational efficiency and scalability.

Requirements

Who You Are
You are a growth-oriented, highly analytical e-commerce operator who thrives on taking ownership and driving measurable outcomes. You have experience working with e-commerce platforms like Amazon and are excited to scale a high-growth business within a collaborative and performance-driven environment.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience managing e-commerce operations, preferably with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.
  • A proven track record of growing revenue, improving profitability, and optimizing sales across e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to make decisions and improve performance.
  • Experience in managing product positioning, pricing strategies, and marketing campaigns.
  • A collaborative, results-driven mindset and a passion for continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage both strategic and tactical elements of e-commerce operations.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly influence how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote-first role with flexible working hours.
  • Benefits:
    • Remote-first work environment
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Access to learning resources and professional development
    • Free access to Hadley Designs products
    • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO
    • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you’re ready to help shape the future of learning in a growing company, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our E-Commerce Business Manager and help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S. If you don’t hear from us within 4 weeks of your application, please consider that we’ve decided to move forward with other candidates. However, we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs!

The Graphic Designer is a top-level production designer in the studio. With prerequisite knowledge of production standards and ways of working, the Graphic Designer is an integral part of the production team; working on a diverse variety of projects from kickoff to final delivery but is additionally responsible for the design work on all higher tier projects, print and digital. This requires more refined design skills, and more comprehensive understanding of and ability to produce high quality print and digital design.

This role requires both creative and technical skills as well as process management expertise. The Graphic Designer must be an expert in production design, creative production techniques, as well as have an eye for good, intentional design, sometimes requiring a “blank sheet” start to a design task or project.

The Graphic Designer works closely with the Creative Director, Studio Manager, and Account/PMO.

What does a day in the life as a Graphic Designer look like?

  • Principal artists for all Tier-3 print and digital design under Creative Director’s guidance
  • Serve as creative leads on specific high tier projects from concept to final delivery
  • Provide continuing mentoring and design-specific education to production artists/and partners via one-on-ones and presentations
  • Manage and prioritize high tier projects
  • Complete assigned design/production tasks, from concept to final delivery
  • Design original artwork, including ads, coupons, and POS promotions
  • Produce hi-fidelity digital comps/layouts for responsive microsites
  • Refine/retouch/clip and mask images
  • Review and follow client brand standards and guidelines
  • Collaborate internally to conceptualize and execute creative solutions that can be translated across various media platforms
  • Work with account and design teams to ensure deadlines are met
  • Stay up to date with industry tools and trends
  • Prepare creative concepts and present to management and PMO/Account teams for collaboration and approval
  • Apply pre-press modifications to artwork to meet defined production specs
  • Maintain and support library of creative/client assets

What are the required qualifications of a Graphic Designer?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Design or equally relevant experience
  • 4+ years as a professional graphic designer/production artist
  • Must possess experience working on a MAC platform and be highly proficient with Adobe CC apps and Microsoft Office (Word, Teams, Powerpoint, Excel)
  • Practical experience with marketing design concepts, brand standards
  • Print production experience is required- understanding of CMYK/spot color, special effects, substrates, and packaging of trouble-free deliverables to varying specs
  • Can prioritize tasks and complete projects on time
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written
  • Experience with training Individuals and groups on technical processes and software and techniques
  • Able to work without supervision
  • Organized and efficient multitasker
  • Sales and/or customer service experience
  • A decisive decision maker
  • A people person with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Experience with managing Project Management Software
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once
  • Portfolio is required
  • Demonstrated experience with Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator

  • Competitive compensation
  • Adherence to government-mandated benefits
  • Retirement Savings Program with Company Matching
  • Life Insurance
  • HMO on day 1
  • Paid time off, birthday leave
  • Bonus and incentive plans
  • Opportunities for skills training and personal and professional development
  • Beautiful office space
  • Free lunch provided daily

SYSTEMS ENGINEER SENIOR

GDIT has been supporting the IHS mission for 20+ years; working with the agency to provide integral services to raise health access and availability to 2.6 million American Indians and Alaska Natives. You'll be part of modernizing the EHR platform to enable better data access, patient experience, and quality of care for 567 tribes, 37 states and over 600 medical facilities.

Our work depends on a Systems Engineer Senior joining our team to support the Indian Health Service (IHS) Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM) program. As a Systems Engineer Senior supporting the IHS EHRM program, you will be responsible for supporting Federal EHR HIT Modernization program activities.

This position is fully remote, US based only. This role requires you to obtain and maintain an in-depth Public Trust Level 5. This investigation will review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

raw.description:
About The Bridgespan Group

The Bridgespan Group (“Bridgespan”) is a global nonprofit that aims to build a better world by strengthening the ability of mission-driven organizations, philanthropists, impact investors, and corporations to achieve breakthrough results in addressing society’s most important challenges and opportunities.

Founded in 2000, Bridgespan has offices in Boston, Johannesburg, Mumbai, New York, San Francisco, and Singapore. Across these six locations, we have a diverse team of staff with varied backgrounds and experience across multiple sectors. We work with social change organizations such as TaRL Africa, Tiko, and CAMFED; philanthropies and foundations such as OSF, Women First Fund, and The Ford Foundation; impact investors such as TPG’s Rise Fund, Black Ambition, and AfricInvest; and bold funding collaboratives such as TED’s Audacious Project and Co-Impact.

Bridgespan aims for a world where all people have the opportunity to flourish. Given how society works today—as manifest in systems and mindsets that have developed over time—that opportunity is not accessible to all. We are committed to equity, specifically to doing work to help ensure that race, gender, and other dimensions of identity are not determinants of life outcomes and to building an organization where the diverse set of individuals we need can thrive in pursuit of their full professional potential, and to proactively addressing the systems that help or hinder these goals. It is a commitment to both external equity work and internal inclusivity that gets Bridgespan closer to achieving its mission.

Position

The Cloud Systems Engineer role is a cloud-first, execution-focused position responsible for administering, configuring, and operating modern IT infrastructure with a primary emphasis on Microsoft Azure and identity services within Microsoft Entra ID.

The role also contributes to cloud engineering and architecture initiatives, infrastructure automation, cloud governance, scalability planning, and modernization. The ideal candidate combines strong operational expertise with hands-on cloud engineering and automation experience.

Part of the IT Infrastructure team, this position ensures cloud and identity platforms are reliable, secure, and aligned with established architectural direction.

Objectives of the Role

  • Ensure reliability, performance, and security of identity systems using Microsoft Entra ID and integrated SaaS platforms.

  • Partner with IT leadership to implement and operationalize cloud and identity solutions.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates to standardize and automate repeatable, scalable cloud infrastructure deployments.

  • Implements and maintains Azure governance including Azure Policy, RBAC standards, tagging, resource organization, and cost optimization.

  • Contribute significantly to cloud modernization and automation initiatives that improve scalability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.

  • Enhance monitoring, alerting, and observability to proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues, minimizing downtime and user impact.

  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Action.

  • Support containerized workloads and cloud-native platforms including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Docker-based deployments.

  • Support and mentor junior team members while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, Conditional Access policies, MFA, and identity lifecycle processes.

  • Administer and support Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, storage accounts, networking, and platform services.

  • Manage Windows Server environments hosted in Azure virtual machines, including Active Directory domain controllers, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.

  • Implement and support identity integrations for enterprise and SaaS applications using SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Support file storage solutions including Azure Files, SharePoint Online, and VM-based file services, ensuring appropriate access controls and data protection.

  • Monitor system performance and availability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tools; respond to and resolve incidents within defined service levels.

  • Execute system updates, patching, vulnerability remediation, and configuration changes across cloud and identity platforms.

  • Support engineering and development teams by provisioning resources, managing access, and troubleshooting infrastructure and identity issues.

  • Manage and resolve infrastructure and identity-related tickets through the service management system, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution.

  • Track and contribute to project work, including executing assigned tasks, updating progress, and identifying risks or blockers.

  • Collaborate with security teams on compliance, risk management, and implementation of security best practices aligned with Zero Trust principles.

  • Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and procedures to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing.

  • Participate in change management processes including planning, testing, and documenting changes in alignment with ITIL practices.

  • Provide escalation support for complex technical issues and participate in on-call support as needed.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

  • 5–8+ years of experience in systems administration, with strong experience in Microsoft Azure cloud environments.

  • Azure certifications: AZ-104 (required), AZ-305 (preferred) and/or identity certifications SC-300 (preferred).

  • Hands-on experience managing Windows Server workloads including Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, and file services in cloud-hosted environments.

  • Strong experience administering Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity governance concepts.

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Teams.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell and/or Azure CLI for automation and administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, Windows systems, and identity platforms.

  • Understanding of authentication and identity protocols including SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Experience working within ticketing systems and tracking operational and project-based work.

  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and support both operational and project-based initiatives.

  • Ability to work independently and remain flexible in a changing environment.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail.

PLEASE NOTE: YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE TO WORK IN THE US WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP, THE BRIDGESPAN GROUP IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

raw.excerpt: We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager to build the operating system for our paid media team, and then run it.
raw.description:
We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager to build the operating system for our paid media team, and then run it.

Sweat Pants Agency manages around 57 brands and spends between $5M and $10M a month across Meta, Google, TikTok, and AppLovin. We're the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands from zero. Our average client stays with us for over three years.

Our email and SMS side is exceptionally well run. Project management there is tight, the templates exist, the dashboards are live, and nothing slips. Our paid media side is not there yet, and that's the job. This role is paid media only, so you won't be splitting your attention across two teams.

Roughly 25 to 30 accounts sit on the paid media side and are yours to keep in order. You'd be the first person in this seat, which means you're not inheriting a process. You're designing one.

The first things you'd own

We think in rocks, meaning the things that need pushing uphill. Here are ours, in priority order.

1. Capacity planning. Right now we don't have a real model for who is working on what, how loaded they are, or what happens when a new account lands. You'd build it: a live view of capacity across media buyers, designers, and video editors, with the ability to see an overload coming two weeks out instead of the day someone misses a deadline.

2. Creative workflow and process. Creative is our biggest bottleneck and it's cross functional. It spans our graphic design team, our video editors, and our media buyers who double as creative strategists. There's no single pipeline from request to delivery right now. You'd build it, run it, and be the person who guarantees we hit the creative volumes we owe clients every month.

3. Creators and UGC. We source creators constantly and there's no system behind it. You'd own sourcing across Billo, Backstage, email, and wherever else the right person is. That means negotiating rates and turnaround, tracking orders, managing usage rights so we never run an ad we've lost the rights to, tracking costs per account, and making sure markups land correctly on client invoices. If you haven't done this before, you should be genuinely comfortable asking a stranger for a better rate.

4. Client onboarding. We have a process and it needs refining, by someone who does this for a living rather than by me. Account access collection (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Klaviyo, Shopify, TikTok), ClickUp setup, reporting and dashboard configuration, so every launch feels identical.

What you'd do day to day

  • Run ClickUp as the single source of truth. Build and maintain templates, recurring tasks, intake forms, automations, and dashboards. Every account has a current status and a named owner, always.
  • Own capacity planning across the paid media team and flag overload before it becomes a missed deliverable.
  • Track every creative deliverable from request to delivery, including revisions and approvals, and QA the work before it reaches a client.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage creators. Track orders, usage rights, and costs.
  • Own client onboarding end to end and standardize it so every launch runs the same way.
  • Build landing pages and advertorials using Claude Code from time to time.
  • Make sure client reporting and dashboards are set up correctly and stay accurate for every account.
  • Build internal tools, automations, and living SOPs using AI so the whole team runs faster and the same way every time.
  • Catch gaps in communication and delivery before they escalate, and drive follow ups to closure.
  • Schedule and coordinate recurring client and internal meetings, capture action items, and make sure they actually get done.
  • Flag at risk accounts early and escalate.

About the landing pages

We don't sell landing pages as a service. We build them anyway, because a weak page is the most common reason good creative doesn't convert, and waiting on a client's dev team costs us weeks.

Our media buyers already build pages this way. You'd do the same: advertorials, presell pages, and landing page variants built with Claude Code off existing templates and shipped to Shopify or the client's stack. You don't need to be an engineer and you won't be architecting anything from scratch. You need to be someone who can take a brief, work with AI to build the page, QA it, and ship it, and who finds that interesting rather than terrifying.

How we work, and please read this part carefully

This is the part most job posts leave out, and it's the part that actually determines whether you'd be happy here.

We give a lot of autonomy and we mean it. Nobody here is on a time clock and nobody ever will be. If I have to think about what you're doing with your hours, we've already lost. I judge outcomes, not activity.

The flip side is that I'm not a gatekeeper. One of the biggest red flags for me is someone who asks a lot of permission questions. Can I change this, should I do that. No. Just do it and show me. If you need a company card to solve something, you'll have one. You have full trust on day one. It's only ever lost, never earned.

Ownership is the thing we care about most. "That wasn't my role" is a disqualifier here. If creative is the bottleneck on an account, you go fix creative, whether or not it was in your scope. We've all done work outside our lane to get the result.

We judge the first 30 days harshly. We're looking for you to take action early and show that you're self directed. We usually know quickly, and it rarely turns around. What I can tell you is that people who make it past that point almost never leave. Our team retention is exceptional.

Mistakes are fine. Patterns aren't. You'll never hear me raise my voice. When something breaks we look at the process, not the person. My Slack tagline is "everything's my fault." But if the same thing breaks repeatedly, that's a fit problem.

My job is to protect the team. We have let go of clients for being unkind to our people and we'll do it again. I ask you to put clients first, and if there's ever a problem, tell me, because I'll put you first.

I like being wrong. Tell me there's a better way. Nothing here is sacred and everything can change.

Where this goes

On our email side, project management became the pipeline into strategy. Several of our email strategists started as PMs. We're building the same path on paid media. If you want to end up as a media buyer or creative strategist, this is the seat that gets you there, and you'll get your hands dirty along the way, writing creative briefs, launching ads, and sitting in on account reviews.

If you'd rather stay in operations and own this function as it grows, that works too. Tell us which one you want.

Our mission is simple: be the no BS agency partner you love working with.

Requirements

Skills

  • Elite organization and follow through. You close loops without being chased.
  • You build project management systems, you don't just work inside them. Hands on experience standing up or substantially rebuilding a system in ClickUp, Asana, or Monday, including spaces, custom fields, templates, statuses, intake, automations, and dashboards. We will ask you to walk us through one you personally designed.
  • Highly AI enabled, and comfortable building rather than just prompting. You've used Claude, Claude Code, or a comparable agentic tool to actually make something, whether that's a page, a dashboard, an automation, or an internal tool. Tell us what it was and what it replaced. This is non negotiable and we test it.
  • Proactive problem solver who anticipates gaps rather than reacting to them.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. This role is partly client facing, so English fluency is required.
  • Comfortable negotiating. A meaningful part of this role is talking to creators about rates, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Comfortable juggling many concurrent projects and context switching across accounts.
  • Detail obsessed, with a high standard for quality and accuracy.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in project management, creative operations, account management, or agency operations, preferably in a marketing or creative agency setting.
  • Proven ability to manage timelines and deliverables across many projects at once.
  • Hands on experience building and managing a project management system in ClickUp or a comparable tool. This is a hard requirement.
  • Demonstrated AI building, not just AI usage. This is a hard requirement.
  • Working hours with meaningful overlap with US business hours.
  • Bonus: experience with paid media or DTC ecommerce.
  • Bonus: experience sourcing and managing UGC creators or influencers.
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify, Figma, or front end tooling.

Benefits

Why Sweatpants Agency?

We’re not your typical agency. We’re the only agency behind multiple INC #1 fastest-growing companies from scratch. We thrive on innovation, creative problem-solving, and delivering results that make our clients say, “Wow.”If you’re ready to join a team that values your skills, pushes you to grow, and gives you the freedom to innovate, then we want to hear from you.

About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services

  • Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 101,000 USD - 140,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. The Product and Advanced Strategies team is comprised of subject matter experts in the areas of financial strategies, practice management, and products. In this role, the individual works closely with annuity and life insurance wholesalers, as well as financial professionals, to leverage the individual’s subject matter expertise in financial planning, tax strategies, estate planning, small business planning, and insurance solutions to drive sales growth and enhance the firm’s relationships and reputation. Duties/Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Product Evangelistto own and scale our non-paid growth engine across search, content, AI-driven discovery (AEO), product-led acquisition, and lifecycle touchpoints.

VIDIZMO is a U.S.-based technology company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, and a Microsoft Solutions Partner across Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Digital & App Innovation. Through our AI-powered Intelligence Hub, we help Fortune 500 enterprises, government agencies, and public sector organizations securely manage, analyze, and govern complex data with full control and compliance.

Our Multimodal AI Data Intelligence Platformuses Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enable advanced capabilities such as automated tagging, redaction, summarization, OCR, translation, subtitle generation, object detection and tracking, intelligent search, sentiment and emotion analysis, topic extraction, document classification, and facial recognition.

Role Overview

As a Remote Product Evangelist at VIDIZMO, you will serve as the global digital voice of our AI-powered video and data solutions. Operating entirely online from Pakistan, you will build trust and drive adoption across international markets by mastering virtual storytelling. You will turn complex technical capabilities—like AI redaction and digital evidence management—into compelling narratives for government and enterprise buyers through webinars, virtual summits, and high-impact digital content.

AI Output Verification & Accountability (Required Competency)

The candidate must be capable of effectively using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to support work outputs such as content, analysis, documentation, or code. However, the candidate must also demonstrate strong judgment and ownership of the final deliverables. AI-generated output must never be treated as final without review. The candidate is expected to validate accuracy, completeness, logic, compliance, and alignment with business requirements, and refine AI-assisted work to meet the expected quality standards. The individual will be held accountable for the final output, regardless of whether AI tools were used during execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Virtual Thought Leadership: Plan and host high-quality live webinars, LinkedIn Live sessions, and virtual roundtables that educate global audiences on solving challenges like "GDPR compliance in video" or "AI in Law Enforcement."
  • Responsibility for reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs
  • Ownership of final deliverables, regardless of AI assistance
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI results and ensure they meet defined requirements
  • Accountability for accuracy, quality, and compliance
  • Digital Demos & Presentations: Conduct polished, high-energy product demonstrations via Zoom/Teams for decision-makers in US/EU time zones, showcasing EnterpriseTube and DEMS without leaving your desk.
  • Content Creation Factory: Produce a consistent stream of digital content, including screen-recorded tutorials, "feature spotlight" videos, white papers, and thought-provoking social media posts that simplify our AI technology.
  • Online Community Engagement: Actively monitor and engage in industry-specific digital communities (e.g., Reddit, LinkedIn groups, Discord) to answer questions, share insights, and build a following around the VIDIZMO brand.
  • Customer Feedback Loop: Synthesize feedback from online interactions and Q&A sessions to provide the product team with actionable insights on user needs and market trends.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years in organic growth, or inbound growth
  • Proven experience with AEO and modern search behavior
  • Strong B2B SaaS or regulated-market experience
  • Ability to connect search demand → content → revenue
  • Comfortable influencing Product and GTM strategy with data
  • Time Zone Flexibility: Willingness to work overlapping hours with US (EST/PST) or European time zones to accommodate live virtual events and meetings.
  • Virtual Presence: exceptional on-camera charisma and communication skills; you must be comfortable speaking to a camera lens as if it were a person.
  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency with streaming tools (OBS, Restream), webinar platforms (Zoom Webinars, ON24), and social media management tools.
  • Technical Understanding: Ability to quickly learn and articulate concepts regarding Cloud Security (Azure/AWS), AI/ML workflows, and Government Compliance (CJIS, FedRAMP).
  • Infrastructure: A reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional home office setup (quiet environment, good lighting, professional microphone/webcam).
  • Ideal Candidate Profile: You are a "tech influencer" at heart who loves teaching others about technology. You can explain the difference between facial recognition and redaction to a non-technical audience in 30 seconds.
    You have prior experience in SaaS presales, technical marketing, or customer success facing Western markets.

Why Join US?

  • Own the narrative and growth of mission-critical products
  • Work closely with executive leadership on strategy and execution
  • Influence product direction through market insight
  • Operate in high-impact markets with real-world outcomes
  • Opportunity to build and scale product marketing as a growth engine

Benefits: Health Insurance (OPD/IPD), Daily Lunch Facility, Separate Maternity Cover, Leave encashment, Car Support Program, Referral Bonus, EOBI, Bi-Annual Increment. Provident Fund, Career Growth, Bonus (benefits vary based on location)

raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike stops breaches. This role ensures we stop them everywhere, not just in one corner of the platform.

Today, our detection teams operate across endpoint, cloud, NG-SIEM, identity, and SaaS security. They're individually strong. But threat actors don't respect domain boundaries, a supply chain attack lands on macOS, pivots through cloud credentials, and exfiltrates via a compromised SaaS app. We need someone who sees the full picture and turns it into detection coverage that outlasts any single campaign.

This function will report directly to the Sr Director of Engineering of the Detection Content Platform Group. This is a high visible, high impact role that will help us solve one of the hardest problems in cybersecurity: making an entire platform detect threats coherently, across every surface, at the speed adversaries operate. Threat actors are AI-force-multiplied, they stand up campaigns in hours and generate permutations on the fly. We need to detect and respond at the same scale and velocity..

What You’ll Do:

  • Own cross-domain detection strategy. Maintain visibility into the detection team's work, endpoint (Windows, macOS, Linux), cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes), NG-SIEM, identity (IDP), SaaS security (Adaptive Shield), and FEM. Identify where the same attack scenario has coverage on one surface but gaps on another, and work with the teams to close those gaps systematically.

  • Design high-fidelity correlation detections. Build detection logic that joins signals across domains, entity resolution, temporal reasoning, behavioral layering. Deliver high-severity, low-FP detections via Platform IOAs (CDE) that resist bypass and remain effective over time.

  • Drive threat-informed prioritization. Monitor internal and external intel sources. Partner with OverWatch, Falcon Complete, product managers across all modules, and customer success teams. Translate threat landscape shifts into concrete detection investment decisions. Top threat scenarios get deep, multi-domain coverage before they hit customer environments.

  • Coordinate cross-team detection development. When a researcher writes a detection for a scenario on one platform, ensure coverage ships across all relevant surfaces simultaneously. No detection ships in isolation when the scenario spans domains.

  • Apply AI/LLM to detection workflows. Identify opportunities to use automation and large language models to accelerate gap analysis, triage threat intel, and prototype correlation logic. Drive adoption of AI-assisted workflows across the detection engineering function.

  • Coach and enable detection engineers across teams. Set technical direction. PR reviews, hands-on technical coaching, co-development on hard problems. Raise the bar for what "good detection" means across the organization.

  • Influence product and platform direction. Identify gaps in telemetry, event coverage, or platform capabilities that limit detection quality. Work with sensor teams, product management, and platform engineering to close those gaps.

What You’ll Need:

  • Strong detection engineering background. Have extensive experience writing production detection content across multiple platforms or data domains. Deep understanding of different telemetry sources, their limitations, and where coverage breaks down.

  • Cross-domain thinking. Demonstrated ability to reason about threats that span multiple surfaces, endpoint to cloud, identity to SaaS, network to runtime. Have designed or contributed to detections that correlate signals across boundaries.

  • Threat landscape fluency. Stay current on threat actors, campaigns, and TTPs. Able to translate threat intelligence into detection requirements and prioritization decisions.

  • Detection content lifecycle experience. Understand what happens when detection libraries scale, aging rules, FP drift, performance cost, deprecation decisions. Have operated in an environment where detection quality is measured and maintained over time.

  • Strong communication and influence. Able to work across multiple teams, drive alignment, and articulate detection strategy to both engineers and leadership. Able to drive outcomes through expertise and relationships.

  • Technical leadership. Have guided or mentored engineers on detection quality, reviewed detection content at scale, or set technical standards for a detection engineering function.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience applying AI/LLM to detection or security operations workflows

  • EDR or SIEM vendor-side product experience

  • MITRE ATT&CK fluency across multiple platforms

  • Published security research (blogs, conference talks, tools, CVEs)

  • Malware analysis or reverse engineering background

  • Experience quantifying detection efficacy (precision, recall, bypass resistance)


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

raw.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

About Landmark

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud-native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on-premises solutions.

About the Role

This role spans the full early-career range. We are hiring new graduates as well as engineers with up to five years of professional experience. If you are a few years in and looking for stronger mentorship, a more technically serious codebase, or a clearer growth path than your current role offers, this posting is for you. Your experience will be reflected in your level, scope, and compensation at offer.

You join a delivery team and start writing production code immediately. You build software with your team that oil and gas operators use every day for real decisions. You debug issues in systems that connect to live data, write features that operators depend on, and learn how professional software teams ship quality code at scale.

You receive regular guidance from experienced engineers and participate in code reviews from the start. Over time, you grow your technical skills and your understanding of the product domain, and you build the habits that make an engineer effective over the long term. We hire for potential and train for success.

Positions are available across a range of teams. Team assignment determines both the product domain you work in and the technologies you use.

Teams build software for domains such as:

  • Geoscience — geology, geophysics, or petrophysics
  • Drilling engineering and well planning
  • Reservoir engineering and modeling
  • Production engineering and optimization
  • E&P data management and integration
  • Cloud and platform infrastructure, data services, and developer tooling
  • AI-assisted analytics, search, and generative AI

Technologies used vary by team and include:

  • Languages such as Java, C#, F#, C++, Python, and TypeScript
  • Frameworks, platforms, and runtimes such as .NET, Eclipse RCP/SWT, JUnit, Angular, React, and Node.js
  • Cloud platforms including Azure and AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD/Flux
  • Relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB

What You Will Do

  • Build, test, and ship features for products in active use by energy companies worldwide
  • Debug and fix defects in production systems, learning how large-scale applications behave under real conditions
  • Write and maintain automated tests as part of the team’s standard delivery workflow
  • Participate in code reviews: read your teammates’ code, receive feedback on yours, and learn the codebase through both activities
  • Follow secure coding practices, triage security issues when they arise, and apply fixes to deliver secure applications
  • Contribute to technical documentation for the systems and features you work on
  • Work within a distributed team across time zones, communicating clearly and consistently about your progress and blockers
  • Research and evaluate open-source tools and libraries that can improve the systems you work on
  • Grow your understanding of the product domain through the work itself

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
  • 0–5 years of software development experience
  • Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language and standard development tooling (version control, build systems, testing frameworks)

Preferred

  • Experience contributing to a shared codebase with other engineers
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), web application development, or data systems
  • Exposure to CI/CD or infrastructure automation tools
  • Interest in technically demanding application domains such as scientific computing, applied AI/ML, real-time systems, large-scale data processing, or similar

Energy industry experience is not required but is a strong plus. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every item in the preferred list.

How You Work

The engineer who succeeds in this role is technically curious and takes their craft seriously. Whether you are writing your first production code or already have a few years behind you, you pick up new tools and techniques quickly, ask good questions when you are unsure, and follow through on the tasks you own. You treat code reviews as a place to both learn and contribute, and you communicate clearly with teammates across time zones.

Why Landmark

We build small, high-ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. You will learn from experienced mentors, grow your skills on technically real problems, and build a strong foundation for a long-term career in software engineering.

We offer competitive compensation, a strong career path, and a role where your contribution makes a difference from day one.

Introductie

Wil jij als SAP Supply Chain Consultant niet alleen werken met de nieuwste technologieën, maar ook bijdragen aan de processen van toonaangevende bedrijven in Nederland? Denk aan klanten in de high-tech, logistiek en maakindustrie die vertrouwen op jouw expertise voor hun logistieke succes. Bij SUPERP maak je écht impact, samen met een team van vakidioten dat verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen.

Over SUPERP

SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. Onze expertise in SAP, Mendix, Salesforce, Microsoft en gebieden als AI, security, analytics, development, integratie en quality assurance zorgt voor slimme, flexibele IT-oplossingen. Bij SUPERP werken echte vakidioten met passie voor hun werk. Mensen die complexe IT-vraagstukken door en door snappen én oplossen. Nuchter, betrokken en recht door zee. We denken mee, zeggen waar het op staat en doen wat werkt.

Functieomschrijving

Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

  • Het leiden van workshops om logistieke processen helder in kaart te brengen.

  • Adviseren over technische oplossingen, architectuur en innovatie.

  • Realiseren van end-to-end oplossingen voor uitdagingen zoals S/4HANA (RISE of GROW) transities, cloudmigraties en procesoptimalisatie.

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij SUPERP geef jij richting aan je eigen carrière. Wij ondersteunen, stimuleren en faciliteren jouw ontwikkeling, zonder vastomlijnde functiehuizen. Wat je verder kunt verwachten:

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 dagen per jaar.

  • Persoonlijke groei: toegang tot de nieuwste technologieën en trainingen.

Proces

In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!

About Working at Commerce

Building a career here is more than just steps on a ladder. It’s about helping people find financial safety and success, helping businesses thrive, and making sure people and their money are taken care of. And our commitment doesn’t stop there. Our culture is about our people, the ones in our communities and the ones that work with us.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow and learn, to connect with others, and build relationships with the people around you. You’ll have the space and resources to grow into the best version of yourself. Because our number one investment is you.

Creating an award-winning culture doesn't come easy. And after 160 years, we know Commerce Bank is only at its best when our people are. If this sounds interesting to you, keep reading and let’s talk.


Compensation Range

Annual Salary: $207,575.00 - $267,000.00 (Amount based on relevant experience, skills, and competencies.)

About This Job

The main purpose of this job is to lead a team of Relationship Manager(s), Portfolio Manager(s), and Commercial Loan Specialist(s) who are responsible for both the comprehensive management of existing commercial relationships as well as soliciting new business opportunities with assigned customers and targeted prospects. Although it can vary by market, targeted companies generally include those with annual revenues in excess of $50MM.

Essential Functions

  • Manage a team of Relationship Managers that serves the banking needs for a particular territory and/or industry, to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and retention

  • Develop departmental goals for new incremental income in conjunction with corporate goals, plans and policies, and coach direct reports on targeted sales activities to maximize new business opportunities, including generally targeting 200 calls per year

  • Ensure that the department is adequately staffed and trained to meet current and future needs. Provide career counseling and ensure that succession planning is addressed for critical roles.

  • Lead all necessary management functions including; hiring, evaluations, annual merit increase allocations and disciplinary actions as necessary

  • Review and analyze portfolio to manage risk, enhance profitability, and inform management/credit of potential challenges

  • Review credit requests, analyzing industry/credit risk including; loan structuring, collateral, ensuring adequate loan documentation, and appropriate pricing

  • Participate in community/industry functions/groups to ensure a positive image for the bank and to establish referral contacts within the marketplace

  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, regulations, and laws

  • Oversee department workflow and effectively communicate decisions, priorities and relevant information to team members

  • Lead, mentor and motivate team members to implement the department strategy, manage workflow with guidance on departmental projects/issues, and provide coaching and development opportunities appropriate to each direct report’s individual needs

  • Manage a team of RMs with a combined portfolio of commercial relationships with some or all of the following characteristics:

    • Avg loan portfolio O/S of $300MM to $500MM

    • Avg deposit portfolio of $50MM to $100MM

    • Annual contribution of $5MM to $10MM

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

  • Strong knowledge of commercial products, credit policies, procedures and terminology; including knowledge of best practices

  • Goal oriented with well-developed sales skills.

  • Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong credit analysis, persuasion, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to develop and coach team members with demonstrated success achieveing results through collaboration and teamwork.

  • Self-starter with strong decision-making skills and the ability to effectively communicate and interact with all levels of the company, clearly expressing ideas and concepts, both verbally and in writing

  • Ability to remain adaptable and resilient in all situations with an optimistic outlook and cast a positive shadow that is aligned with our culture and Core Values

  • Ability to maintain a valid driver’s license, and meet Commerce Bank’s driving record criteria; ongoing employment may be contingent upon meeting all driving requirements.

  • Intermediate level proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required

  • Master’s degree in Business preferred

  • 6+ years of commercial banking experience required

  • 2+ years leadership experience required

  • Experience with structuring complex credit requests preferred

***For individuals applying, assigned and/or hired to work in areas with pay transparency requirements, Commerce is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for some roles. This compensation range is for the Division Manager I, Commercial Banking job and contemplates a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to location, skill sets, education, relevant experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has been adjusted for any applicable differentials (geographic, bilingual, or shift) that could be associated with the position or where it is filled. At Commerce, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each situation. A reasonable estimate of the current base pay is $207,575 to $267,000 annually. This position will be eligible for additional compensation through performance-based incentive plan(s) that will correspond to meeting performance goals.

The candidate selected for this position may be eligible for the following employment benefits: employer sponsored health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), life insurance, paid vacation, and paid personal time. Job Description:

Own the opportunity as a Network Manager and help ensure the mission is never interrupted. At GDIT, we deliver clarity with our cloud solutions and provide meaningful work. Your work will be an important part of transforming our clients for the modern age and help them face any obstacle.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Network Manager, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Network Manager joining our dynamic team to lead a general Network Engineering organization that spans traditional routing and switching, cloud networking, enterprise network security, visibility, and modern operations. We are looking for a proven people and technical leader who is forward-thinking, excited about emerging technologies, and able to drive delivery across a high-performing team in an environment of customer mission delivery, integrity, and clear communications.

We are looking for someone who brings deep experience across Cisco routing/switching, cloud networking, next-generation firewalls and SASE platforms, network visibility and microsegmentation, and modern monitoring/observability tools — and who thrives on evaluating and adopting new technologies that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency. If you love leading technical teams, staying ahead of the technology curve, and delivering program milestones, we would love to hear from you!

HOW A NETWORK MANAGER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Leads and develops the general Network Engineering team responsible for enterprise routing and switching, cloud networking, network security services (including next-generation firewalls, SASE/SSE, microsegmentation, and related controls), network visibility, and monitoring/observability platforms.
  • Owns overall operational delivery, service health, and continuous improvement across the network domain; establishes priorities, allocates work, and ensures the team meets program milestones, SLAs, and customer expectations.
  • Provides strong people leadership: coaching, performance management, career development, hiring support, and retention of high-performing technical talent; fosters a culture of accountability, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Champions a forward-thinking technology strategy; actively evaluates emerging networking, cloud, security, and observability technologies and drives adoption of solutions that improve reliability, security posture, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Serves as a primary escalation point for complex technical and operational issues across routing/switching, cloud networking, network security, and monitoring domains; coordinates with senior engineers on architecture decisions, major incidents, and high-risk changes.
  • Partners with Program Management, security operations, cloud, infrastructure, and other Service Tower leads to ensure seamless cross-domain integration and end-to-end service delivery.
  • Manages stakeholder relationships with customers and partners; represents the Network Engineering team in operational reviews, architecture discussions, change control forums, and technology roadmap conversations.
  • Drives capacity planning, resource forecasting, and coordination of hardware, software, cloud, and tooling investments in support of network service delivery.
  • Ensures documentation, runbooks, knowledge transfer, monitoring coverage, and operational readiness standards are maintained across the team; supports audit and compliance activities as needed.
  • Promotes automation, infrastructure-as-code mindsets, and modern operational practices that reduce toil and improve consistency across traditional and cloud networking environments.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Required Education: BA/BS or equivalent experience

Required Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering and operations, including people leadership or technical management experience overseeing network engineering teams in a managed services, government, or large enterprise environment

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • Core Networking: Strong hands-on and architectural knowledge of Cisco routing and switching (including enterprise campus, data center, and WAN technologies); experience with modern routing protocols, switching fabrics, and network design best practices
  • Cloud Networking: Practical experience with cloud networking constructs across major providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) including VPCs/VNets, transit architectures, hybrid connectivity, and cloud-native networking services
  • Network Security: Working knowledge of next-generation firewalls and SASE platforms (Palo Alto Networks NGFW, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Prisma Access, and/or GlobalProtect); familiarity with microsegmentation (Illumio and/or Gigamon/ExtraHop), policy analysis tools (AlgoSec or equivalent), and WAF technologies (F5 Distributed Cloud or equivalent)
  • Visibility & Monitoring: Experience with enterprise network monitoring and observability platforms such as SolarWinds, ScienceLogic, NetBrain, and/or comparable tools (e.g., ThousandEyes, ExtraHop, Gigamon visibility fabric); ability to drive effective use of these tools for performance, capacity, and fault management
  • Strong understanding of ITIL / ITSM practices, change management, and operational governance
  • Proven track record of evaluating and successfully introducing new networking, cloud, or observability technologies
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams through complex transitions, migrations, technology refreshes, or multi-domain network transformations in large enterprise or multi-tenant environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated experience delivering briefings and status to senior customer and internal leadership
  • Strong people leadership and coaching skills
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Forward-thinking mindset with genuine enthusiasm for evaluating and adopting new networking, cloud, security, and observability technologies

Certification(s):

  • Must possess Cisco certification (CCNP / CCIE) -or- equivalent depth of experience in routing and switching
  • Must possess Palo Alto Networks certification (PCNSE / PCSAE or higher) -or- equivalent deep platform experience

Security Clearance Level: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret or higher clearance.

US Citizenship Required

Location:

  • Candidates more than 60 miles from GDIT's Integrated Technology Center in Bossier City, LA but still a Louisiana resident will follow a remote work model

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore an enterprise IT career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your desire to drive operations forward.

The likely salary range for this position is $127,500 - $172,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation.
