What You Will Do:

Partner with product owners, architects, developers, and cloud engineers to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle for application modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

Analyze business, functional, technical, and cloud architecture requirements to develop comprehensive quality engineering strategies and test approaches.

Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks supporting web applications, APIs, microservices, cloud-native solutions, and data integration platforms.

Develop and execute automated functional, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing across modernized application environments.

Support enterprise application modernization efforts, including migration of legacy Oracle-based applications and databases to AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows to enable continuous testing, rapid feedback, and high-quality software releases.

Collaborate with Agile Scrum teams to define acceptance criteria, ensure testability of requirements, and establish quality gates throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Develop and maintain automation scripts, test data, test harnesses, and reusable testing assets to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

Identify, troubleshoot, and perform root cause analysis of defects, working closely with development teams to resolve issues and prevent recurrence.

Utilize modern testing and AI-enabled quality engineering tools to improve test coverage, reduce manual effort, and accelerate release cycles.

Establish quality metrics, automation KPIs, and reporting dashboards to measure software quality, release readiness, and modernization success.

Participate in architecture, design, and sprint reviews to ensure applications are scalable, secure, accessible, and aligned with cloud modernization objectives.

  • Experience working on full software development lifecycle (SDLC) projects in Agile and Scrum environments.

  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end automated test coverage for enterprise applications.

  • Experience testing APIs, web services, integrations, cloud-native applications, and distributed systems.

  • Experience integrating automated testing within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

  • Experience validating data migration, conversion, and integration efforts associated with application modernization initiatives.

  • Experience creating comprehensive test plans, test strategies, test cases, and quality documentation.

  • Strong understanding of SQL, database testing, and data validation methodologies.

DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.

The Customer Success Engineer is a post-sales technical expert responsible for driving adoption, consumption, and measurable outcomes from deployed GenAI applications. Customer Success Engineers serve as the technical bridge between developers and DataRobot’s platform, ensuring customers maximize value from using DataRobot. They work closely with Account Owner, Engagement Directors, and Professional Services teams to accelerate time-to-value, support expansion motions, and reduce churn risk through continuous enablement and use case optimization.

  • Accelerate Onboarding & Initial Application Adoption: Guide customers through first-use milestones by enabling key personas, resolving blockers, and ensuring consumption of initial apps deployed during onboarding.

  • Drive Ongoing Consumption: Monitor usage, identify underutilized apps / stalled users, and engage with customers to increase activation and business impact.

  • Customer Health Monitoring: Actively track product usage, satisfaction, and success milestones to surface risk early and coordinate mitigation plans.

  • Technical Advocacy & Solution Feedback: Act as the voice of the customer to DataRobot product and engineering teams, channeling technical requirements, gaps, and enhancement requests.

  • Technical Enablement & Training: Deliver targeted, scalable enablement sessions and create reusable knowledge-sharing materials designed for diverse audiences across accounts.

  • Use Case Value Realization: Collaborate with Engagement Directors to ensure learning initiatives align with business goals and capture feedback and outcomes for executive reviews.

Job Description:

The Performance Tester supports the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program for the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (AO) by designing, executing, and analyzing performance, load, and scalability tests for enterprise-class applications deployed in the AWS cloud. Working as part of Agile DevSecOps teams, this role ensures that CMM applications built using React, NodeJS, and AWS meet or exceed defined performance, reliability, and capacity objectives. The Performance Tester identifies performance bottlenecks, validates system resilience, and collaborates closely with development and infrastructure teams to optimize end-to-end system performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests to validate system scalability and responsiveness.
  • Define performance benchmarks and KPIs based on application SLAs, SOW requirements, and user load models.
  • Build, configure, and maintain performance test environments in AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Design test scripts using JMeter, LoadRunner, or K6, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance monitoring.
  • Conduct baseline performance analysis and capacity planning for major CMM components.
  • Collaborate with developers, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to identify performance bottlenecks and tune system configurations.
  • Analyze test results and prepare detailed performance reports, recommending optimization strategies.
  • Validate that application releases meet federal performance and reliability standards prior to production deployment.
  • Support failover and stress testing scenarios to verify system fault tolerance and scalability under load.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide performance insights during sprint planning and retrospectives.

Tools & Technologies:

  • Performance testing: JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, K6.
  • Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack.
  • CI/CD integration: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions.
  • Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, or Grafana dashboards.
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, MS Teams.

Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or relevant field)
  • 5+ years of experience with integration, regression, and system testing using automated testing tools in web-based applications
  • 5+ years of experience in software performance testing and engineering, with 3+ years in cloud-based or distributed systems.
  • Experience in writing test cases, test plans, executing test scripts, reporting defects and preparing test results reports
  • Experience in the entire QA Life Cycle, including designing, developing and execution on the entire QA process and documentation of test plans, test cases, test procedures and test scripts
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript for scripting, test development, and automation across modern performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or K6.
  • Strong knowledge of performance engineering principles, including concurrency modeling, resource utilization, and tuning.
  • Experience testing applications in AWS cloud environments (EC2, ECS, CloudWatch, RDS).
  • Working understanding of NodeJS, REST APIs, microservices, and front-end frameworks such as ReactJS.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration for automated performance test execution.
  • Ability to interpret system logs, metrics, and profiling data to diagnose bottlenecks.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, ELK Stack, or Grafana.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience with federal or enterprise-scale application performance testing.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Understanding of network performance testing and distributed tracing techniques.
  • Exposure to AI-driven performance analytics or predictive capacity modeling.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cost optimization for cloud-based performance tuning.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

Certifications:

  • ISTQB Performance Testing Certification (CT-PT) – preferred.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or DevOps Engineer – preferred.
  • SAFe Practitioner (SPC/SSM) – beneficial.
  • Performance Engineering Certification – a plus.

raw.description:
Position Title: Full-Stack QA Engineer

Reporting Line: Reports directly to the QA Lead.

Location: Fully Remote

General Purpose: Own and continuously improve product quality by testing new features, identifying defects, creating automated tests, recommending process and product improvements, and developing strong feature and product knowledge.

Specific Objectives (~12 months):

  • Develop strong product and feature knowledge to independently test assigned product areas.
  • Deliver reliable, consistent, and clearly documented testing outcomes.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of quality across assigned product areas throughout the development and release lifecycle.
  • Support and expand automated test coverage across agreed product areas.

Key Activities:

  • Perform thorough functional, integration, API, regression, and exploratory testing of assigned features and product areas.
  • Review requirements and acceptance criteria to identify quality risks, gaps, and unclear behavior.
  • Document defects clearly, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for assigned product features and regression scenarios.
  • Investigate failed or unstable automated tests and improve test-suite reliability.
  • Continuously build product and technical knowledge by reviewing relevant documentation and project updates.
  • Ask timely and relevant questions to clarify requirements, risks, and expected product behavior.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and the QA Lead to investigate and resolve quality issues.
  • Participate in release validation and clearly communicate quality risks before deployment.
  • Use approved AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate testing activities, and streamline day-to-day QA work.
  • Demonstrate active engagement and ownership of product quality throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Requirements

Key Competences:

  • Strong ownership of and accountability for product quality.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong quality assurance mindset.
  • Genuine interest in the product and motivation to understand how its features and underlying systems work.
  • Ability to consider the broader product context rather than focusing only on individual test steps.
  • Commitment to improving the product and continuously developing as a QA specialist.
  • Practical experience in web application testing.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch effectively between different tasks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests.
  • Ability to use approved AI tools effectively to improve testing quality and productivity.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests (E2E: TypeScript/JavaScript with Playwright; API integration testing: Python).

Likely Current Job:

  • Full-Stack QA Engineer or Senior Full-Stack QA Engineer.
  • QA Engineer combining manual and automated testing responsibilities.
  • Currently employed by companies operating in forex, trading, cryptocurrency, or financial services.

Benefits

Employer Value Proposition:

  • Take meaningful ownership of product quality while working on complex financial products and engaging features in a fully remote company.
  • Develop automation and AI capabilities through practical day-to-day application, with direct opportunities to improve testing processes and product outcomes.

Compensation: Competitive base salary with eligibility for performance-based bonuses.

Assessment Process:

  • First-stage interview with the QA Lead and Product Owner.
  • Final-stage interview with the CTO.

Technology Practice

Michael Baker International’s Technology Practice partners with organizations to design, build, and scale innovative digital solutions that drive measurable business impact. The practice brings together product strategists, engineers, architects, data experts, and transformation leaders to solve complex challenges across cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, enterprise platforms, and modern application development. What We're Looking For

Michael Baker International is seeking a Program Manager, ERP Transformation to join its Technology Practice in a Remote, United States capacity. In this senior-level role, you will lead the planning, execution, governance, and value realization of a complex Oracle Fusion ERP transformation, aligning business, IT, implementation partners, and executive stakeholders around integrated delivery, organizational readiness, and measurable modernization outcomes. This role is designed for a leader who can drive enterprise-scale program performance while maintaining discipline across scope, schedule, quality, risk, and stakeholder engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end Oracle Fusion ERP transformation program, delivering integrated scope, schedule, quality, and readiness outcomes from discovery through transition to support.
  • Drive program governance through stage gates, RAID management, dependency tracking, decision logs, and executive reporting that enables timely decisions and disciplined delivery.
  • Oversee the integrated master schedule, critical path, milestone attainment, and phase-entry and phase-exit criteria to keep the program aligned to business objectives.
  • Govern program-level scope, change control, and requirements traceability to protect delivery integrity and prevent unmanaged scope growth.
  • Direct Systems Integrator and vendor performance, ensuring deliverable quality, milestone acceptance, SOW alignment, and accountability to contractual commitments.

  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across business, IT, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data governance, and compliance to support enterprise-ready solution decisions.
  • Develop and drive organizational readiness, hypercare governance, and transition-to-support planning that improves adoption, continuity, and long-term value realization.
  • Identify and advance AI, automation, analytics, and process modernization opportunities within the Oracle ecosystem to improve efficiency and business performance.

What You Need to Succeed

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of program or project management experience.
  • Minimum 7 years leading large ERP implementations or enterprise transformation programs.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion and at least 3 full implementations.
  • Experience leading ERP programs through governance, testing, deployment, cutover, go-live, and transition to support.
  • Experience managing Systems Integrators, vendor performance, SOW alignment, and executive stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP implementation lifecycles and PMO governance models.
  • Strong capabilities in RAID management, change control, stage gates, testing governance, data migration, and cutover readiness.
  • Ability to lead matrixed teams, communicate complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and facilitate executive decision-making.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational readiness skills, with the ability to travel domestically as needed.

Preferred:

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud experience across Financials, PPM, Procurement, HCM, EPM, integrations, reporting, and security design.
  • Experience in professional services, engineering, or construction environments and with AI-enabled business transformation and advanced analytics.

Compensation

The approximate compensation range for this position is $124,000 to $165,000. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

Overview:

Mitel is seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Developer to join our Security Engineering team and build internal web-based tools that support secure software development. In this role, you will take ownership of projects from design to deployment, designing and developing applications that streamline processes such as software inventory, vulnerability tracking, license compliance, and automation for DevSecOps workflows. You will collaborate with a geographically dispersed team to deliver scalable, efficient solutions that improve developer productivity and strengthen overall security. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong web development experience and an interest in learning secure development practices. You don’t need to be a security expert. We’ll provide guidance and resources to help you grow in this area.

  • Product Ownership: Work closely with users and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable product requirements

  • Software Architecture and Design: Collaborate with development teams to design and implement robust solutions.

  • Application Development: Enhance, optimize, and deploy in-house tools to address evolving needs and streamline workflows.

  • API Integration: Integrate APIs to enable seamless communication between systems and support automation.

  • Security Development Lifecycle Practices: Design tools to automate our SDL processes including vulnerability, license and compliance management.

Mandatory qualifications:

  • Computer Science, Engineering, or related field degree or equivalent technical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in application development, ideally in web applications.

  • Proficiency in web application development using PHP/Yii2 or other modern frameworks such as Java Spring, .NET, Node.js, or Python/Django. Experience with PHP/Yii2 is a plus but not required.

  • Experience with Python for scripting and automation.

  • Familiarity with MySQL and SQL.

  • Experience with Docker for containerization.

  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

Desirable qualifications::

  • Familiar with SDL practices and automation.

  • Interest in learning secure development practices and familiarity with basic security concepts is a plus (e.g., vulnerability management, compliance)

  • Experience with one or more of the following tools: Mend SCA, Jira/JQL, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline and JFrog Artifactory.

For more information, visit Why Mitel or follow us on LinkedIn here.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Our Property and Casualty (P&C) Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As an Actuarial Sr Consultant, you’ll need to have detailed familiarity with business operations, systems, and actuarial methodologies. We’ll count on you to be adept at complex actuarial techniques and work independently to combine advanced actuarial and business knowledge to provide high-level analysis. Additionally, you’ll have expertise to provide consultation and recommendations on deliverables and maintain detailed documentation of actuarial models and analyses. You’ll work independently and may lead others.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a technical expert of actuarial methodologies allowing the ability to source and manipulate data within standard requirements.

  • Conducts complex analyses, adhering to actuarial standards, by selecting appropriate data sources, making assumptions, recognizing considerations, and developing recommendations. Resolves unreasonable results/non-optimal solutions using experience and professional judgment. Begins using results to influence decisions at a higher level.

  • Accurately documents assumptions, methods, sources, and considerations in an organized fashion.

  • Prepares and presents actuarial findings and documents that are suitable for technical and non-technical audiences at the senior Actuarial leadership level. May professionally represent company's position with regulators, auditors, and external vendors. May negotiate within defined parameters.

  • Develops cross functional work plans and ensures accurate work product is delivered.

  • Leads cross functional peer reviews to increase collaboration, ensure quality work, and drive innovation.

  • Builds business relationships and leads cross functional communication with team members, customers, and business partners.

  • Leads onboarding and training for new associates on standard work processes. Assists in creating new training materials.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Undergraduate degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science or similar background requiring modeling, programming or quantitative analysis.

License/Certification/Designation: Generally attained ACAS and is working towards FCAS or recently attained FCAS. PLEASE REFER TO THE NATIONWIDE PC INSURANCE COMPANY ACTUARIAL STUDENT PROGRAM FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

Experience: Generally, six or more years of actuarial experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Detailed knowledge of actuarial business functions, statistical methods of analysis, actuarial models, actuarial software and databases. Proficient in Microsoft Office products, analytical software and programming languages. Should have basic competencies including command skills, strategic agility, delegation, motivating others, business perspective and accounting. Should have highly-developed competencies in business understanding, problem solving, customer focus, dealing with ambiguity, drive for results, and learning ability.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

raw.title: Application Support Analyst / L2 Technical Support Engineer (RSNT11082026)
raw.excerpt: About Us Buddle was founded to address the growing demand for reliable and efficient staffing solutions across diverse industries globally.
raw.description:
About Us

Buddle was founded to address the growing demand for reliable and efficient staffing solutions across diverse industries globally. Our mission is to seamlessly connect businesses with skilled professionals, fostering long-term partnerships that benefit both parties. At Buddle, we prioritise trust, value, and sustainability in every staffing solution we provide.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical, proactive, and technically skilled Application Support Analyst / L2 Technical Support Engineer to join our client's technology team within the railway technology and signalling industry. The company develops and supports technology solutions that improve the operational delivery of rail services, including traffic management systems, simulation and training systems, digital platforms, and other business-critical applications. The role will support the implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and ongoing operation of these systems to help ensure reliable and effective service delivery.

The ideal candidate has a strong Level 2 Application or Technical Support background, with hands-on experience across Linux and Windows environments, networking, infrastructure, and application troubleshooting. You will be comfortable investigating complex technical issues, analysing system logs, working with monitoring and ITSM tools, and collaborating with both technical teams and customers to resolve incidents effectively. Rail industry experience is not required. Experience supporting business-critical applications, systems, or technology environments where reliability and service continuity are important will be highly relevant.

This is a remote role supporting business-critical systems and will require the ability to work independently within a structured 4-on, 4-off overnight shift environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor internally developed applications, infrastructure, and customer environments for system health, availability, and performance.
  • Monitor system alerts and proactively triage incidents based on severity, urgency, and business impact.
  • Provide Level 2 application and technical support for business-critical systems.
  • Investigate application, operating system, infrastructure, and connectivity issues across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Analyse system logs and technical information to identify issues and potential root causes.
  • Perform structured troubleshooting and implement or recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Respond to support requests and incidents within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Escalate complex issues to relevant technical teams and subject matter experts while providing clear technical findings and supporting information.
  • Support remote incident resolution and assist with technical activities required to maintain service availability.

Technical Support & Systems Administration

  • Support and maintain applications, systems, and associated technical equipment in accordance with documented designs and procedures.
  • Perform software installations, updates, configurations, troubleshooting, and application deployments.
  • Support on-premise, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Assist with maintaining system configurations and ensuring operational readiness.
  • Support monitoring solutions for applications and infrastructure environments.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Apply knowledge of standard networking protocols, ports, and network services when investigating technical incidents.
  • Assist with the configuration and troubleshooting of network devices such as switches, routers, and firewalls where required.
  • Use network monitoring and analysis tools to investigate connectivity, performance, and infrastructure issues.
  • Procure, configure, and issue replacement hardware and devices when required.
  • Utilize ITSM and CRM platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, ServiceDesk, ServiceHub, or similar tools to log, track, manage, and resolve incidents and service requests.

Technical Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

  • Work closely with internal technical teams, developers, engineers, and subject matter experts to investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders regarding incidents, technical issues, progress, and resolutions.
  • Translate technical information into clear and understandable updates for non-technical stakeholders where required.
  • Engage with technical teams to understand requirements, evaluate technical solutions, and support the implementation of best practices.
  • Contribute to the implementation and support of new technologies and technical solutions.
  • Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across different technical and operational functions.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge-sharing to other technical colleagues where appropriate.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Clearly document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting activities, and solutions within the ITSM system.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures, and support records.
  • Prepare incident reports, post-incident reviews, and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation where required.
  • Contribute to and maintain internal knowledge bases and technical support documentation.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to reduce future incidents.
  • Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, support procedures, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and raise process improvement opportunities through the appropriate channels.
  • Support the adoption of DevOps and Agile practices within the technical support environment.

Other Responsibilities

  • Ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents in accordance with agreed SLAs and internal service expectations.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical activities, incidents, system changes, and resolutions.
  • Follow incident management, change management, and operational support procedures.
  • Understand and follow documented operating procedures, maintenance instructions, and technical guidelines.
  • Support business continuity by participating in system monitoring and operational readiness activities.
  • Maintain a strong focus on system reliability, service quality, and customer experience.
  • Participate in training, product familiarisation, and knowledge-sharing activities as required.

About You

  • 3+ years of experience in Application Support, Level 2 Technical Support, Systems Support, Infrastructure Support, or a similar technical role.
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting both Linux and Windows operating environments.
  • Experience with system and network configuration, software installation, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyse system logs and identify potential root causes.
  • Working knowledge of Bash scripting for troubleshooting, automation, or routine technical tasks.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, standard internet protocols, ports, and network services.
  • Experience with network monitoring and analysis tools.
  • Experience troubleshooting or configuring network devices such as switches, routers, and firewalls.
  • Experience supporting on-premise, cloud, and/or hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Experience supporting applications or systems where reliability, availability, and timely incident resolution are important.
  • Experience using ITSM or CRM platforms, such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, ServiceDesk, ServiceHub, or similar tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct structured technical investigations.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) and documenting technical incidents and resolutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing technical support environment is highly regarded.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with DevOps and Agile methodologies.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL is advantageous.
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in an incident-focused support environment.
  • A proactive, self-led learner with the ability and drive to investigate unfamiliar technical issues and develop new technical knowledge.
  • Comfortable collaborating with multiple technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Resilient and able to manage workload effectively in a fast-paced, business-critical support environment.
  • Comfortable working overnight shifts and supporting business-critical systems outside standard business hours.
  • Willingness to work a 4-on, 4-off shift pattern consisting of 12-hour shifts, providing 24/7 operational coverage.
  • Rail industry experience is not required; experience supporting business-critical systems or essential business services is highly relevant.

Finer Details

Working Pattern:

Remote / Home-Based

4 days on / 4 days off

12-hour overnight shifts

Shift hours: 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM

The role provides support for business-critical applications and systems requiring 24/7 operational coverage.

Training and onboarding will follow a structured schedule before transitioning to the regular 4-on, 4-off overnight shift pattern.

Occasional participation in training, technical workshops, product familiarisation, or other client activities may be required.

Salary: 70,000 - 100,000

As a State C&I Senior Manager in our Tax Credits & Incentives Advisory (TCIA) Practice, you will work with an excellent team of CPAs and tax law experts. The group offers unparalleled knowledge and service in the area of tax credits and accounting methods and helps companies identify and realize value-added opportunities.

About the company

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 20 studios in 14 countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences.

Experience our side of life. For more information, visit www.side.inc.

About the role

As a Translator / Linguist, you’ll play a key role in bringing video game worlds to life for players in Italian markets. You’ll handle a mix of translation and editing tasks, ensuring that every line of text, from in-game dialogue to UI and legal materials, reflects the intended tone, style, and cultural nuance, using a creative translation approach as needed. Working as part of a multilingual localization team, you’ll help deliver high-quality, immersive experiences that resonate with players around the world.

The CloudOps & DevOps – Hybrid Engineer supports the Juno Labs team by maintaining and enhancing secure data flows between Kafka, PostgreSQL, and S3. Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain secure Kafka-PostgreSQL-S3 data flow architectures to support project initiatives Configure and manage secure access controls for all observability roles across tools and platforms Test and validate OpenTelemetry flows to ensure accurate and secure data collection Coordinate access provisioning and user setup for stakeholders, ensuring adherence to security and compliance requirements Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and security teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and improve operational efficiency Monitor system health, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability and performance of data pipelines Integrate observability solutions (logs, metrics, and traces) to ensure full visibility into hybrid cloud infrastructure Implement security best practices for data in transit and at rest across all integrated systems Document processes, configurations, and security controls to support knowledge sharing and compliance standards Enhance infrastructure and tooling to improve scalability, performance, and security for ongoing and future initiatives Other duties as assigned

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • U.S. Citizenship (required for work on designated client projects)
  • Demonstrated experience in CloudOps and/or DevOps roles supporting hybrid cloud environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, and S3 data flows
  • Awareness of FedRAMP, HIPPAA and SOC2 protocols
  • Proficiency with OpenTelemetry and observability frameworks
  • Proven ability to secure cloud data pipelines and manage role-based access control
  • Experience with containerized deployment and promotion pipelines (Docker/ECR/EKS/Fargate/AKS/GKE)
  • Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams for user setup and secure access
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD tools, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)

raw.excerpt: Looking for an opportunity to make an impact? The Leidos Energy, Infrastructure, and Automation operation helps solve utilities’ complex challenges through our full life-cycle, performance-based solutions.
raw.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

The Leidos Energy, Infrastructure, and Automation operation helps solve utilities’ complex challenges through our full life-cycle, performance-based solutions. Our services include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning for electric power substations and transmission and distribution lines; protection and controls design; and electrification programs. Utilities consistently come to Leidos for reliable power expertise, as reflected through our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and more than 100 municipals/cooperatives across the country as well as a growing number of private developers.

Your greatest work is ahead!

We are in search of a Senior Microgrid Control and Automation Engineer to join our diverse and fast-paced organization. As a core team member, you will be interacting with other electric utility disciplines, playing a valuable part in leading and designing microgrid and renewable energy projects.

This opportunity can be fully remote. Must be willing to travel to the office or client sites as needed.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Utilize familiarity with microgrids' control systems and automation technologies, such as supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, energy management systems (EMS), Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), Human Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Remote Terminal Units (RTUs).
  • Apply understanding of microgrid concepts, including islanding operation, grid-connected operation, energy management, control strategies, and power flow management within a microgrid system.
  • Participate in Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Test (SAT).
  • Perform Hardware in the Loop (HIL) testing.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of various renewable energy technologies such as solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, wind turbines, batteries, and other distributed energy resources (DERs).
  • Use experience with power electronics and their application in renewable energy systems and microgrids, including inverters, converters, and other power electronic devices to interface and control DERs.
  • Perform planning and engineering in support of telecommunication systems and telecommunication projects.
  • Establish project schedules and budgets.
  • Develop drawings and specifications for utility telecommunication system projects.
  • Coordinate with other internal engineering departments, external contractors, and utility construction crews.
  • Travel to project sites to collect information on existing conditions.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in CAD software for electrical system design, simulation tools for modeling and analysis, and programming languages commonly used in microgrid control systems.
  • Apply knowledge of commonly utilized communication protocols (DNP, SEL, MMS, Modbus, etc.).
  • Utilize experience with Protection & Control design concepts, including one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring, etc.
  • Use experience with commonly utilized system modeling software programs (ASPEN, CAPE, CYME, ETAP, SKM, etc.).
  • Employ experience with DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61131 Programming, AcSELerator RTAC, SEL 5030 Quickset, GE Cimplicity, and Protocol Test Software preferred.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with four to eight plus years of related microgrid experience.
  • Strong knowledge of microgrid and renewable energies.
  • Protection and control of power system experience.
  • Capability to learn a variety of client software packages and databases.
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Work, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Outlook).
  • Must be comfortable in both a field and office setting.
  • Ability to support field work occasionally in rough terrain in order to access remote project locations.
  • Valid US driver license and able to lift 20 pounds.

Favorable if you have:

  • Fundamentals of Engineering certification.
  • Master’s degree in a related field.

In this role, you can expect to grow:

  • With opportunities for both technical and non-technical training.
  • Interface with utility clients
  • Technical & Non-Technical Training Opportunities.
  • Leadership Opportunities.
  • Mentorship & Training Opportunities.
  • Opportunity to Lead, Grow, and Inspire a Dynamic Team.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00

Board Liaison

Permanent

Executive

Union of Concerned Scientists

Remote

Bargaining Unit Position: No

Our Organization

The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives.

For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include:

  • Science in the service of people and the planet.
  • Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations.
  • Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.
  • Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.
  • Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.
  • Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.

The Position

The Board Liaison will work with the Chief of Staff and Chief Development Officer to help coordinate and support the UCS Board of Directors including meeting planning and logistics, onboard new board members, and support board activities and governance. The Board Liaison also directly works with and supports the CEO and President in her engagement and relationship building with Board members, as well as in preparation for all Board meetings. The position will also oversee strategy for Board events, cultivation, and stewardship, and provide event support for other high profile UCS events, such as National Advisory Board (NAB) and other prominent programmatic events. Further, the Board Liaison will support the UCS Development team to implement and execute communications strategies to educate, engage, and inspire our Board and NAB members about the breadth and depth of UCS work and accomplishments. The Board Liaison will work closely with the Chief of Staff and Chief Development Officer to coordinate and plan the Board meetings, support high-profile UCS events virtually and in-person, oversee Board data entry in the UCS CRM, maintain the Board document repository, manage Board stewardship initiatives, and other tasks as needed.

The Liaison will also work closely with the following, as appropriate:

  • Director, Stewardship, Events and Engagement
  • Associate Manager, Stewardship, Events, and Engagement
  • Administrative Manager to the President
  • Special Assistant to the Executive Office

Responsibilities

· Serves as the primary liaison to members of the UCS Board of Directors for meeting coordination, strategic communications, questions, and updates. This includes supporting and attending Board Executive Committee meetings, and regular Board committee meetings (e.g., Audit, Development, Finance, Investments, JEDI, and Governance Committees). The Board Liaison will support Executive Team members in their support of Board Committees (e.g., CFO/COO for Finance, Audit, and Investment Committees).

· Communicates proactively with, and is responsive to, the President and CEO and Chief of Staff. Establish regular communication with both Executive and Development Departments for effective coordination and collaboration.

· Provide exceptional customer service and relationship management with Board members in tight coordination with UCS President and senior leadership staff.

· Plans and executes UCS Board meetings and related board events, including but not limited to: Board meeting prep and materials, day-of-meeting assistance, Board dinners, and Friends of UCS event receptions. Manages the creation and editing of the Board book

· Manages new board member onboarding and emeritus board member off boarding, in collaboration with the Chair of the Governance Committee.

· Serves as a critical thought partner on organization-wide events, including on stewardship and engagement concepts. Assists in the planning, coordination, and execution of high visibility events that benefit the organization to advance enterprise-level priorities, working closely with the Director and Associate Manager of Stewardship, Events and Engagement

· Helps the Chief of Staff, the Director of Stewardship, and the Chief Development Officer to identify new engagement opportunities for the Board in partnership with the Development team

· Serve as a thought partner on stewardship and engagement concepts for the National Advisory Board (NAB) members in connection to UCS work and Development staff . With support and oversight of the Director of Stewardship, Events and Engagement, contribute to implementation of the onboarding plan for new National Advisory Board members

· With direction from Director of Stewardship, Events and Engagement, as needed, support with planning and logistics of UCS National Advisory Board (NAB) meetings and events, as appropriate, and including but not limited to meeting prep and materials, day-of meeting assistance, NAB field trips, meeting receptions, and post-event debrief and database updates

OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED include but are not limited to:

· Entry for non-Major Gift Officer-related NAB and Board updates and emails into Mission CRM Database

· Assist with sharing of timely and regular UCS updates and newsletters with the Board or NAB as needed, and in consultation with relevant Departments including Development and Communications

· Assist Board members with technical issues, connecting with IT as appropriate

· Help ensure that organizational equity work and speakers from diverse backgrounds are appropriately represented throughout programs, and UCS’s commitment to justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion is represented in program content.

· Become sufficiently knowledgeable of project management systems (Monday.com) the CRM systems (Mission CRM and EveryAction), communications channels, and file storage (Board repository on SharePoint) while maintaining organization of the event scheduling process and UCS event calendar.

· Maintain familiarity with the breadth and dept of UCS programs and fundraising models to contribute to the development of the annual workplan and annual budget.

· Maintain awareness and stay up to date on benchmarks and best practices of non-profit board engagement.

· Help run virtual events, including but not limited to content prep sessions and co-hosting the Zoom platform to assist with presentations, attendee chat management, and audience questions

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY

May supervise consultants, and/or UCS staff who directly support events and the UCS Board, as appropriate.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

· Spends extended periods at computer monitor and keyboard; ability to control a mouse and keyboard.

· Modest exertion: Ability to Lift 50Lbs, lifting of boxes, movement of tables and chairs and other mobility to execute events as needed.

· Communicate in verbal and written formats with internal staff and external constituents.

WORK SCHEDULE

Regular office hours. Some nights and weekend are required during events and NAB meetings.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

10-20 days annually of travel (day- and overnight-travel) for Board meeting, NAB meetings, and other events as needed.

EEO STATEMENT

UCS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth)

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

· Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills. Experience with event planning preferred.

· Previous experience providing exceptional management and customer service of an organization’s board of directors especially in a non-profit setting. Familiarity with donor relations techniques and principles required.

· Detail oriented, strong proofreading skills, experience with social media platforms desired.

· Vendor management experience required. Leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills required.

· Able to communicate effectively and quickly and work flexibly in a team environment and across departments is critical.

· Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills required; experience with merge functions and knowledge of donor databases required.

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. At UCS, comparable training and/or experience can be substituted for degrees when appropriate.

· 5 - 7 years of comparable events and project management experience is required. Project Management Certification a plus.

Benefits

Details:

This is a full-time remote position. For those who meet all position requirements, the salary is $109,232. UCS offers excellent benefits and a rewarding work environment. *CA Resident Only, we offer a 12% salary differential*

Information about the organization is available at .

Comparable training and/or experience can be substituted for degrees when appropriate.

More about the team:

Our team is made up of a dedicated group of researchers, scientists, communicators, campaigners, and advocates from wide-ranging backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and a collaborative and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. We continually strive to create an environment which is a welcoming place for the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, parents, empty-nesters, and people with a wide variety of interests and backgrounds.

To Apply: We know there are great candidates who won’t check all these boxes, and we also know you might bring important skills that we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. Please upload a cover letter and resume. In the cover letter, please confirm that the listed salary meets your expectations. Upload materials in Word or PDF format only. No phone calls, please.

This position is NOT in the bargaining unit.

Covid Mandate for New Hires:

For in office roles, UCS employees must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Employees are considered fully vaccinated as defined by the CDC. All new hires who will be reporting to an office location must provide notice of their vaccination status and vaccination documentation, on or before their first day of work. For all others, UCS strongly encourages full vaccinations among its employees, up to and including booster shots, even if working remotely.

All new employees must comply with the mandatory vaccination requirements outlined in UCS policies as soon as practicable. Union of Concerned Scientists will notify candidates for employment of the requirements of this policy before the start of employment.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT DYSRUPITDysrupIT is a consulting-led technology firm.
raw.description:
ABOUT DYSRUPIT

DysrupIT is a consulting-led technology firm. We help mid-market to enterprise businesses solve business problems through technology — whether that's consulting, execution, managed services, or staff augmentation — and we take accountability for the outcome. We are dedicated to making a positive impact in the communities we serve.

COMPANY CULTURE

At DysrupIT, success isn't measured in headcount placed or hours billed — it's measured in outcomes delivered. We're a team that takes ownership of the work, stays curious about problems beyond our immediate scope, and builds relationships meant to grow, not just renew or end. We invest in our people with the training and support they need to grow their careers, and we back a culture where everyone, regardless of role, is encouraged to notice opportunities, ask one more question, and help lead the story for our clients, not just deliver it.

JOB SUMMARY

The Infrastructure & Platform Operations Engineer supports, maintains and improves the infrastructure and production platforms used to deliver Nephos services to customers. The jobholder works across cloud / on-premise infrastructure, Linux, networking, databases, containers, monitoring and enterprise platforms, with a strong initial focus on BAU production support, service stability and knowledge transfer. As capability develops, the role will also contribute to platform change, upgrades, automation and project delivery.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Working hours: 9–5 UK hours during onboarding and transition, with flexibility for occasional out-of-hours upgrades, changes and major incidents.

  • Work as part of Service Operations to support enterprise infrastructure and production platforms, including health monitoring, issue resolution, proactive maintenance, resilience and continuous improvement.
  • Administer, support and troubleshoot customer environments, including core infrastructure, storage, networking, IAM awareness, compute resources and managed services relevant to supported platforms.
  • Support Linux environments, primarily Ubuntu and Red Hat, using command-line administration and troubleshooting techniques; provide appropriate support for Windows where required.
  • Diagnose complex network and connectivity issues across TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, TLS, proxies, load balancers and cloud networking.
  • Administer and support PostgreSQL production environments, including configuration, roles and permissions, monitoring, backup and restore, recovery, performance investigation and upgrades.
  • Administer and support MongoDB production environments, including health, logs, performance, backup and recovery, upgrades and troubleshooting.
  • Support containerised and orchestrated environments using Docker and Kubernetes, including container lifecycle, logs, configuration, volumes, networking, registries, health checks, resource constraints and failure diagnosis.
  • Support cloud container services and clusters, including AWS with EKS and ECS where applicable, and contribute to platform configuration, health and capacity management.
  • Monitor infrastructure and applications using enterprise monitoring and observability tools, including alert investigation, log analysis, threshold review, root-cause identification and reduction of unnecessary alert noise.
  • Use scripting and automation, particularly Python and PowerShell, to improve repeatability, reduce manual effort and support operational tasks; Bash or other transferable scripting experience is also valuable.
  • Use Git and GitHub to manage scripts, configuration and operational content, following appropriate version-control practices.
  • Support enterprise platform installations, configuration, upgrades, testing, validation and recovery, including data platforms such as BigID and internally developed solutions such as Nephos-developed platforms where customer access is approved.
  • Learn and develop operational capability in new or unfamiliar enterprise platforms quickly, using structured knowledge transfer, documentation, practical shadowing and independent task completion.
  • Take ownership of Incident and Problem records, applying structured troubleshooting to identify issues, restore service as quickly and safely as possible, complete root-cause analysis and maintain accurate records.
  • Take ownership of Service Requests and technical operational tasks, ensuring work is completed accurately, securely and within agreed priorities.
  • Manage Change records relating to infrastructure, databases, platforms, upgrades and improvement activity, attending CAB where required and ensuring implementation, validation and rollback plans are appropriate.
  • Create and maintain clear knowledge articles, runbooks and work instructions, and actively participate in cross-training so that critical operational knowledge is not concentrated with one individual.
  • Work directly with customer and internal technical teams during incidents, changes, upgrades and investigations, explaining findings clearly and maintaining a professional, customer-focused approach.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, Data Services, Product, Delivery and other cross-functional teams to resolve issues and deliver end-to-end platform outcomes.
  • Contribute technical input to platform improvements, resilience, capacity, monitoring and operational design. Final architecture and governance decisions remain shared internal responsibilities.
  • Support backup, restore and disaster-recovery activities, including practical validation and recovery exercises.
  • Work in accordance with security principles including least privilege, secure credential handling, secrets, certificates, auditability, patching and vulnerability awareness.
  • Access to individual customer environments remains subject to the relevant customer contractual, security and access approval processes.
  • The role is focused on operating, supporting, deploying and improving production platforms rather than developing application functionality.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, systems engineering or production support; demonstrable capability is more important than a fixed number of years.
  • Strong, practical BAU and production support experience, including ownership of live incidents, service restoration, monitoring, failed changes or deployments, root-cause analysis and controlled remediation.
  • Strong hands-on AWS experience in production environments. AWS is the primary cloud requirement for this role.
  • Very strong demonstrable Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, particularly Ubuntu and Red Hat, including confident command-line use.
  • Deep practical networking and connectivity troubleshooting experience covering TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, TLS and cloud networking.
  • Strong production MongoDB administration and troubleshooting experience. This is a critical capability for the role.
  • Meaningful PostgreSQL operational experience, including administration, backup and recovery, monitoring and troubleshooting; deeper production DBA experience is highly valued.
  • Hands-on production experience with Docker and a strong working knowledge of container lifecycle, networking, logging, health and troubleshooting.
  • Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including deployment health, pods, services, configuration, logs and failure diagnosis.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and platforms through installation, configuration, version upgrades, health monitoring and technical troubleshooting.
  • Strong scripting and automation capability, particularly Python and/or PowerShell; experience with Bash or other transferable scripting languages is also relevant.
  • Strong monitoring and observability fundamentals, including infrastructure metrics, log investigation, alert analysis and distinguishing symptoms from root cause.
  • Excellent issue analysis, troubleshooting and fault-finding skills, with a methodical approach to complex production problems.
  • Working knowledge of Git and GitHub, including repositories, version control and collaborative working practices.
  • Practical understanding of backup, restore, recovery and service-resilience principles.
  • Practical IT service management experience covering Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and major-incident processes. Formal ITIL certification is not mandatory.
  • Experience using a service-management platform such as Jira/JSM, ServiceNow, Remedy, Freshservice or equivalent.
  • Good security awareness, including least privilege, IAM concepts, secrets, certificates, MFA, privileged access, patching, vulnerability awareness and secure credential handling.
  • Strong customer-centric attitude with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during normal operations and incidents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear technical documentation and operational procedures.
  • Demonstrable ability to learn complex unfamiliar technology and become independently effective following structured onboarding and knowledge transfer.
  • Able to work independently following onboarding, manage multiple priorities and recognise when escalation or wider technical input is required.
  • Flexible, organised and self-motivated, with willingness to participate in occasional out-of-hours upgrades, changes and major incidents where required.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on Azure experience. Azure is expected to become increasingly relevant, although AWS remains the primary current requirement.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform and services such as Cloud Run or Cloud SQL.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code principles and tooling such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and deployment pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps.
  • Previous experience with BigID or another complex enterprise data-governance platform. BigID experience is not required, but the ability to learn it is important.
  • Experience with RabbitMQ, Redis or similar messaging/cache technologies.
  • Experience with LogicMonitor or comparable enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Experience using privileged-access and secrets-management technologies such as Delinea and HashiCorp tooling.
  • Experience with REST APIs and API troubleshooting.
  • Experience in applying, renewing and troubleshooting TLS certificates.
  • Experience with disaster-recovery planning, RPO/RTO considerations and practical recovery testing.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information security or regulated customer environments.
  • Relevant AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or ITIL certifications. Certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Experience supporting microservices, serverless or distributed platform architectures.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Government-mandated benefits plus supplemental HMO coverage.
  • Collaborative and professional work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities within a growing technology organization.
  • Hybrid/Remote work arrangement (where applicable).

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:
The Director, Regulatory Change Initiatives plays a critical role in leading complex compliance-related change initiatives within CrossCountry Mortgage. This role functions as an advanced business analyst for regulatory change, responsible for translating Legal’s impact assessments into detailed business, system, and process requirements and then driving those changes into workable system, process, control, and documentation changes. This role partners closely with Legal, Operations, Technology, Risk, and other stakeholders to ensure compliance changes are implemented effectively, validated appropriately, and documented thoroughly. The Director, Regulatory Change Initiatives serves as a senior resource to the team by helping structure work, resolve ambiguity, and guide less experienced team members.

Job Responsibilities:
• Own medium-to-large regulatory and compliance change tickets from start to finish, including intake, scope clarification, assignment coordination, status tracking, and closure documentation.
• Serve as a senior business analyst for regulatory changes by translating Legal and business needs into clear business, technology, and procedural requirements that cross‑functional stakeholders can understand and execute.
• Partner with Legal following regulatory impact assessments to determine required system, process, control, and policy or procedure updates.
• Draft detailed requirements for system-related changes, including configuration updates, decisioning changes, workflow changes, new fields, and related technology enhancements.
• Work with Technology teams, business partners, and external vendors to implement approved compliance-related system changes accurately and efficiently.
• Design and document practical non-technology solutions when a regulatory or compliance issue requires process updates, control enhancements, or new or revised policies and procedures rather than a system change.
• Lead the compliance workstream for cross-functional projects by coordinating and monitoring implementation deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder responsibilities.
• Conduct research and analysis of regulatory requirements, existing controls, operational processes, and current-state workflows to support sound solution development.
• Plan, coordinate, and support validation and testing activities for compliance-related changes, including system testing, process walkthroughs, and control verification.
• Review testing results, investigate gaps, and drive follow-up actions to ensure implemented changes address the underlying compliance issue or regulatory requirement.
• Prepare clear project summaries, status updates, and dashboards for leadership and governance meetings, highlighting implementation metrics, key risks, decisions needed, and overall program trends.
• Maintain complete and defensible documentation of decisions, requirements, testing evidence, approvals, and implementation outcomes to support audit, examination, and internal review needs.
• Identify recurring issues or workflow gaps and recommend processes, systems, or documentation improvements that strengthen operational efficiency and compliance controls.
• Facilitate implementation meetings and communicate clearly and consistently with Legal, Operations, Technology, Risk, leadership, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives moving and issues visible.
• Provide informal guidance to analysts and coordinators on ticket structure, requirements development, risk thinking, testing expectations, and documentation standards.
• Support continuous improvement of the Regulatory and Compliance Change Management program.

Qualifications and Skills:
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience in compliance management, regulatory change, or business analysis related to compliance and technology change, with an excellent understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance best practices.
• Experience in mortgage operations, preferably front-end mortgage operations, and a practical understanding of how regulatory requirements affect real-world workflows.
• Experience with Encompass Loan Origination Software or similar loan origination systems, preferred.
• Experience developing, coordinating, or evaluating validation and testing activities related to compliance, process, or technology changes.
• Skilled in translating regulatory guidance, investor requirements, or internal policy expectations into system behavior, business requirements, process updates, and documentation changes.
• Excellent problem-solving skills, including navigating ambiguous situations and identifying the appropriate questions, stakeholders, risks, and next steps when information is incomplete.
• Skilled at working independently, managing ambiguity, and developing practical, defensible recommendations without requiring step-by-step direction.
• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, including identifying gaps in requirements, testing, controls, policies and procedures, or supporting documentation.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining complex compliance issues in practical business terms across multiple audiences.
• Advanced organizational, prioritization, and time management skills, effectively managing multiple tickets or workstreams simultaneously.
• Skilled at documenting work thoroughly so that the rationale, implementation steps, and evidence supporting a change are clear to auditors, examiners, and internal reviewers.
